_readme: One place for the facts the whole site repeats. build.py reads this file, expands the {{TOKENS}}, and hands it to the page as window.__SITE__. It also feeds the search-engine fallback, the structured data, llms.txt and pricing.md, so nothing here can drift apart. Edit here, run `python3 build.py`, commit docs/.

shipping._note: Must match Shopify > Markets > India > Shipping. When `free` is true the site says so on the ribbon, product pages and cart. If you add a paid rate below a threshold, set freeFrom to that amount (0 = free on everything).

forms._note: Paste a form endpoint that accepts a JSON POST (Formspree, Web3Forms, a Google Apps Script web app). While this is empty the newsletter box is replaced by an Instagram follow button and the contact form opens WhatsApp or email, so nothing a visitor types is ever silently dropped.

tracking._note: The pixel is off while metaPixelId is empty. Filling it in loads the Meta Pixel on pastforward.shop (PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout); use the same pixel id Shopify's Facebook & Instagram channel uses, so the whole journey is one funnel. Before switching it on, change the 'Your cart and cookies' line in the privacy policy below, which currently says the site uses no trackers. Campaign tags (utm_*, fbclid) are passed to the Shopify checkout whether or not the pixel is on.

faq: Is it a real vinyl record?
Yes. A real 12-inch upcycled record. Every record we sell already had a life before it got to you; we clean it up and set the artwork into the centre label. Nothing is pressed new for decor.
Can I play it?

It's sold to hang, not to play. These are real records, so the grooves are real — but we make no promise about what's on them or how it sounds, and the label carries our artwork rather than the original. Treat it as a wall piece.
Why upcycled and not new?
Because a record that already had a life is the whole point of the name. It also means no two are identical, and nothing new gets pressed just to hang on a wall.
What sizes do you make?
{{SIZES}}
How does a record hang?
Every record comes with a wall hook in the box. Put the hook up and hang the record on it.
How long does delivery take?
{{DELIVERY}} from when you order, anywhere in India.
What does delivery cost?
{{SHIPPING_LINE}}
How can I pay?
By {{PAYMENTS}}, on a secure checkout. {{COD_LINE}}
Do you ship outside India?
Not yet. We deliver anywhere in India for now.
What if it arrives damaged?
Email {{EMAIL_LINK}} within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we'll put it right. See returns.
Can you make one that isn't on the site?
Yes. That's what custom orders are for — tell us the artist and album and we'll make it.
How do I look after it?
Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep it out of direct sunlight — same as the original.

shipping: Every piece is made to order. Your order reaches you within {{DELIVERY}} of being placed.
Any delivery charge is shown at checkout, before you pay.
Please check your delivery address and phone number before you order. If something's wrong, email {{EMAIL_LINK}} as soon as you can and we'll fix it before it ships.
Email {{EMAIL_LINK}}. We usually reply right away.
returns: Each piece is printed and put together for your order, so we can't take returns if you change your mind.

If your order arrives damaged, or isn't what you ordered, email {{EMAIL_LINK}} within 7 days of delivery. Include your order details and photos of the piece and the packaging. We'll send a replacement, or refund you if we can't.
Our records are upcycled: real vinyl that already had a life. Small surface marks on the record are part of that history and aren't counted as damage.
Approved refunds go back to the original payment method.
privacy: Only what you give us. When you order: your name, delivery address, phone number and email, so we can deliver. When you use a form: what you type in it, such as your name, email, WhatsApp number, message, or a link to the artwork you want. When you join the list: your email.
To make and deliver your order, to reply to you, and, if you joined the list, to tell you about new drops. You can leave the list at any time.
Payments are handled by our payment provider. We never see or store your card or bank details.
Only the people who need it to get your order to you, such as our payment provider and delivery partner. We don't sell your data.

Your cart is saved in your own browser so it's still there when you come back. This site uses the Meta Pixel to measure which ads and posts bring visitors and sales, and to show our ads to people who have visited. You can control this in your Facebook or Instagram ad settings.
You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email {{EMAIL_LINK}}.
terms: PastForward makes wall decor from music: upcycled vinyl records with album art at the centre, posters, prints and polaroid cards. By ordering from this site you agree to these terms.
Our records are for hanging, not playing. Prints are made to order, and colours can look slightly different from how they appear on your screen.
Prices are in Indian rupees. An order is confirmed once payment goes through. If we ever can't fulfil an order, we'll tell you and refund you in full.
When you send us an image or artwork to print, you confirm you have the right to use it.
Album artwork, artist names and titles belong to their respective owners. PastForward is not affiliated with or endorsed by any artist or label.
See our shipping and returns policies.
We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed.
These terms are governed by the laws of India.

sections: Real records, not prints of records

Every piece is a real 12-inch vinyl record that already had a life. We clean it up and set your album's artwork into the centre label, so what goes on the wall has the weight, shine and grooves of an actual record. Nothing is pressed new just to hang.
How it hangs
A wall hook comes in the box. Put the hook up, hang the record. One record works above a desk or bed; three or more in a row turn a plain wall into a feature wall.
Price and delivery
{{PRICE_VINYL}} a record. {{SHIPPING_LINE}} It reaches you in {{DELIVERY}}, and if it arrives damaged we replace it.
faq: Can I play the record?
It's sold to hang, not to play. The grooves are real, but the label carries our artwork and we make no promise about how it sounds.
How big is it?
A standard 12-inch record, about 305mm across.
Can you make a record for an album that isn't listed?
Yes. Tell us the artist and album on the custom orders page.

sections: Five ways to put an album on a wall

An upcycled 12-inch vinyl record ({{PRICE_VINYL}}), an A3 poster ({{PRICE_A3}}), an A5 poster ({{PRICE_A5}}), a 10×10 square print ({{PRICE_10}}) or a polaroid-style card ({{PRICE_POLAROID}}). Most albums come in several of these, so one artist can fill a whole wall.
Building a wall that doesn't look planned
Start with one record as the anchor, put two posters either side, then scatter polaroids around the edges. Keep it to one genre or one era and it looks curated. Mix eras and it looks like a life.
